title: TravelRequest
description: The normalised assessment request the public API hands to the agent. The API owns request_id and derives ownership from the access token; a client can never assert another user's trip.

departure_time.description: ISO-8601 with the offset the traveller selected. Must not be earlier than the configured backdating allowance.

return_time.description: Must be strictly after departure_time when present.

question.description: Free text from the traveller. Control characters are normalised away before storage; the text is untrusted and is never treated as an instruction.

live_location_consent_id.description: Present only when the traveller granted LOCATION_LIVE for this run.
